description: Traefik dashboard for traefik-internal / traefik-edge (k3s). Metrics via VictoriaMetrics (Prometheus datasource), logs via VictoriaLogs.

targets.query: kubernetes.container_name:"$instance" AND DownstreamStatus:>=400 | stats by (RouterName, DownstreamStatus) count() as errors | sort by (errors desc) | limit 20

targets.expr: kubernetes.container_name:"$instance" | stats by (DownstreamStatus) count() as requests
targets.query: kubernetes.container_name:"$instance" | stats by (_time:5m, DownstreamStatus) count() as requests

targets.expr: kubernetes.container_name:"$instance" | stats by (ClientAddr) count() as requests | sort by (requests desc) | limit 10
targets.query: kubernetes.container_name:"$instance" | stats by (ClientAddr) count() as requests | sort by (requests desc) | limit 10

targets.expr: kubernetes.container_name:"$instance" | stats by (RequestPath) count() as requests | sort by (requests desc) | limit 10
targets.query: kubernetes.container_name:"$instance" | stats by (RequestPath) count() as requests | sort by (requests desc) | limit 10

targets.expr: kubernetes.container_name:"$instance" | sort by (Duration desc) | limit 20 | fields _time, RequestHost, RequestPath, RequestMethod, DownstreamStatus, Duration, ClientAddr
targets.query: kubernetes.container_name:"$instance" | sort by (Duration desc) | limit 20 | fields _time, RequestHost, RequestPath, RequestMethod, DownstreamStatus, Duration, ClientAddr

targets.expr: kubernetes.container_name:"$instance" AND DownstreamStatus:>=500 | format "<RequestMethod> <RequestPath> -> <DownstreamStatus> (<Duration>ns) client=<ClientAddr> host=<RequestHost>" as _msg

title: Traefik Overview
